dct_description_sm:
Represents the number of budgeted FTE’s associated with positions by Department and Collective Bargaining Unit. These totals are different from Employee Count totals. The FTE count is used for budget purposes to quantify the number of positions approved by Council and funded through the tax and rate-based operating budgets. The FTE count includes full-time, part-time, salary, wage, casual and student positions.

Accuracy: There are no known errors in the data.

Update Frequency: Twice a Year – 30 June and 31 December

Contact: Melisa Lessard

Download note: If you are having problems downloading using Microsoft Edge as your web browser, try disabling the “Open Office files in the browser” option in Settings.
